summary: Admitted and ingested LinkFree v0.72.0 (EddieHubCommunity/BioDrop, archived) at commit 367d772. All six gates pass; 653 blobs reconcile blob-for-blob, zero LFS, archives byte-identical. Corrected three scout claims: the pin is the CHILD of the annotated v0.72.0 tag (trees differ only in reviewpad.yml), the repo declares conflicting Node 16 (CI) vs 15 (Dockerfile), and avatar egress cascades to dicebear on error. Baseline GREEN: npm ci (1825 entries) plus the unmodified declared build ran all three steps (generate.js codegen, CRA 5.0.1/webpack 5.73.0, purgecss 619824->50728 B). Redacted 561 contributor usernames from probe-tree.json into an aggregate digest. Cypress suite not run.
open_questions: The packet pinned 367d772, which is one commit AFTER the annotated v0.72.0 tag (target e527a935b9d37d8cde6db40f15c99ace4005280a); the trees differ only in reviewpad.yml, a CI bot config. Substitution is forbidden so I ingested the sha as ordered, but the PM may prefer to re-pin to the tag target so the slug names the ref exactly.

The upstream cypress suite (9 scenarios covering all four journeys) was not run: the Cypress binary download host is outside the consented acquisition allowlist. A follow-on unit needs its own network consent for it.

Whether contributors would intend their 561 personal profile files to be redistributed inside a migration-evidence corpus is not settled by the MIT grant; recorded as unresolved in license.json. generate.js is corpus-agnostic, so a synthetic corpus can be substituted, but the upstream cypress scenarios assert on specific real profiles and would need rewriting.
